name: Indiginus Blue Street Brass
help: Indiginus Blue Street Brass. We set Key Vel amount 0 and Mod Whl amount full (CC24 / CC25) at every pass, so CC1 is the dynamics; vibrato is in the patch (the "Vib" variants). Pick the patch with the dial until the CC15 map is entered (Brass Ensemble 21 for sections, a solo horn such as Soaring Trumpet 7 for lines): write the keyswitch test (a CC15 sweep, one note per value) and note each patch's value in "instrumentValues". Legato is switched by C-1 / D-1 (12 / 14) automatically. Narrow "range" to the patch's playable keys.
